title: Regen yggdrasil-derivation.json + re-scope binding_invariant test to upstream binding (6 reds)
description: 1p2r child. tests/test_vectors.py::test_yggdrasil_derivation_vector fails 6/7 on current main. Two coupled fixes: (1) regenerate test/vectors/yggdrasil-derivation.json ygg_addr fields to upstream AddrForKey values (oracle: pinned anchor / live yggdrasil-go; iid fields stay link-local); (2) the test's binding_invariant branch (test_vectors.py ~2355) asserts addr.packed[8:16]==iid — the REJECTED native IID-equality invariant per spec/decisions.jsonl upstream-yggdrasil-addressing; re-scope to assert addr == upstream AddrForKey(pubkey) and that the SHA-512 IID is NOT embedded in the routable address. This is settled-decision enforcement, NOT a design question. No dedicated generator exists for this corpus.
